```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(crosstalk)
library(leaflet)

source("web_scraper.R")

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "rustico_properties.sqlite")

# Prefer the parsed properties table; fall back to inline parsing from raw
n_props <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM properties")$n

if (n_props > 0) {
  props <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT p.*, r.last_seen, r.is_active, r.image_url
    FROM properties p
    JOIN raw_properties r ON r.id = p.raw_id
  ")
} else {
  raw <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM raw_properties ORDER BY page, position")
  props <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(raw)), function(i) {
    row   <- raw[i, ]
    parsed <- parse_property_text(row$raw_text)
    parsed$property_link <- row$property_link
    parsed$is_active     <- row$is_active
    parsed$last_seen     <- row$last_seen
    parsed$image_url     <- row$image_url
    parsed$image_path    <- NA_character_
    parsed
  }))
}

dbDisconnect(con)

active  <- props[!is.na(props$is_active) & props$is_active == 1, ]
n_total <- nrow(props)
n_active <- nrow(active)

prices     <- active$price_chf[!is.na(active$price_chf)]
avg_price  <- if (length(prices) > 0) round(mean(prices) / 1000) else NA
min_price  <- if (length(prices) > 0) min(prices) / 1000 else NA
max_price  <- if (length(prices) > 0) max(prices) / 1000 else NA

# Compute PLZ centroids for map markers
zip_all   <- st_read("data/AMTOVZ_GDB_LV95.gdb", layer = "AMTOVZ_ZIP", quiet = TRUE)
plzs      <- unique(active$postal_code[!is.na(active$postal_code)])
zip_cents <- zip_all[as.character(zip_all$ZIP4) %in% plzs, ] |>
  dplyr::mutate(postal_code = as.character(ZIP4)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(postal_code) |>
  dplyr::summarise(.groups = "drop") |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_centroid()
coords      <- st_coordinates(zip_cents)
centroid_df <- data.frame(postal_code = zip_cents$postal_code,
                          map_lng = coords[, 1], map_lat = coords[, 2],
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# One row per property with display columns + coordinates for crosstalk
map_data <- merge(active, centroid_df, by = "postal_code", all.x = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Title = {
      slug <- sub(".*[/]([^/?]+)(\\?.*)?$", "\\1", property_link)
      slug <- sub("[-_][0-9]{5,}$", "", slug)
      text <- trimws(gsub(" {2,}", " ", gsub("[-_]+", " ", slug)))
      text <- gsub("((?:[^ ]+ ){4})", "\\1<br>", text, perl = TRUE)
      paste0('<a href="', property_link, '" target="_blank"><small>', text, '</small></a>')
    },
    Location        = paste0(postal_code, " ", city),
    Region          = region,
    Price           = round(price_chf / 1000),
    `Living m²`     = living_area_m2,
    `Plot m²`       = plot_area_m2,
    Rooms           = rooms_n,
    WC              = wc_n,
    `Bäder`         = bathrooms_n,
    Floors          = floors_n,
    Baujahr         = build_year_n,
    Condition       = condition,
    Zweitwohnsitz   = secondary_home,
    Parking         = parking,
    Lage            = lage,
    Ausblick        = ausblick,
    `ÖV (m)`        = public_transport_m,
    `Autobahn (km)` = dist_highway_km,
    `Stadt (km)`    = dist_city_km,
    Schulen         = schools,
    Garten          = garden,
    Keywords        = ifelse(!is.na(interesting_keywords), interesting_keywords, ""),
    Blacklist       = ifelse(!is.na(blacklist_keywords), blacklist_keywords, ""),
    popup_html      = paste0(
      "<b>", paste0(postal_code, " ", city), "</b><br>",
      "CHF ", ifelse(!is.na(price_chf),
                     formatC(price_chf, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = "'"), "—"),
      "<br>",
      ifelse(!is.na(rooms_n), paste0(rooms_n, " Zimmer<br>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(living_area_m2), paste0(living_area_m2, " m² living<br>"), ""),
      ifelse(!is.na(condition), paste0(condition, "<br>"), ""),
      '<a href="', property_link, '" target="_blank">open listing</a>'
    ),
    lat             = map_lat,
    lng             = map_lng
  )

shared <- SharedData$new(map_data)
```

### Properties

```{r}
library(DT)

datatable(
  shared,
  escape    = FALSE,
  rownames  = FALSE,
  filter    = "top",
  options   = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    order      = list(list(3, "asc")),   # sort by price ascending
    columnDefs = list(
      list(targets = 22,            visible = FALSE),  # Blacklist
      list(targets = c(23, 24, 25), visible = FALSE)   # popup_html, lat, lng
    )
  )
) |>
  formatStyle(
    "Keywords",
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(0, c("white", "#e8f5e9")),
    target = "cell"
  ) |>
  formatStyle(
    "Blacklist",
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(0, c("white", "#ffebee")),
    target = "cell"
  )
```

### Map

```{r}
# Swisstopo WMTS raster tiles (EPSG:3857 / Web Mercator)
sw_attr <- '\u00a9 <a href="https://www.swisstopo.admin.ch">swisstopo</a>'
sw_tile <- function(layer, ext = "jpeg")
  paste0("https://wmts.geo.admin.ch/1.0.0/", layer,
         "/default/current/3857/{z}/{x}/{y}.", ext)

leaflet(shared) |>
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = sw_tile("ch.swisstopo.pixelkarte-grau"),
    attribution = sw_attr,
    group = "Swisstopo Grey"
  ) |>
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = sw_tile("ch.swisstopo.pixelkarte-farbe"),
    attribution = sw_attr,
    group = "Swisstopo Colour"
  ) |>
  addTiles(
    urlTemplate = sw_tile("ch.swisstopo.swissimage"),
    attribution = sw_attr,
    group = "Aerial"
  ) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap, group = "OpenStreetMap") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng            = ~lng,
    lat            = ~lat,
    radius         = 12,
    color          = "#333",
    weight         = 2,
    fillColor      = "#e05c1a",
    fillOpacity    = 0.9,
    popup          = ~popup_html,
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(maxClusterRadius = 40)
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Swisstopo Grey", "Swisstopo Colour", "Aerial", "OpenStreetMap"),
    options    = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
